mapper.insert: INSERT INTO generation_task (request_id, app_id, user_id, code_gen_type, execution_state, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{appId}, #{userId}, #{codeGenType}, 'RUNNING', #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE generation_task SET cancel_requested_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL
